fix(camellia): improve version dialog inputs

Summary:
- replace version release links textarea with input-based editing
- add Windows-specific X86 and X64 link serialization in the dialog
- switch release time editing to a picker-backed datetime-local input

Rationale:
- match the requested version dialog UX for single-link and Windows builds
- preserve legacy Windows link data by mapping fallback entries into X86/X64
- avoid free-text release timestamps when the browser can provide a chooser

Tests:
- cd theaceae && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run check:camellia
